title: Astrid & William
subtitle: Full Wedding Stationary Suite Design
desc:
For Astrid and Will's wedding stationery, the goal was to capture the effortless romance of an Italian summer.

Drawing inspiration from the timeless romance of Lake Como and sun-drenched
Tuscan estates, these designs channel a sense of old-world European opulence while remaining relaxed enough for a lakeside venue.

The final design suite utilises a palette pulled directly from the villa's natural gardens and stone terraces, of soft dusty blue, earthy terracotta, and pops of fresh lemon yellow.
